notes.title: Title: The 2nd Open Beta ends
notes.content:
Dear Patchers,

We have presented the demo version of “The Patcher” as the title of the 2nd Open Beta test.

Your valuable opinions so far will be much appreciated for the official release version development.

Now, the demo version gameplay will end as of time below.

[b]Nov 22, 2023 19:00(PST)
Nov 23, 2023 03:00(UTC)
Nov 23, 2023 12:00(KST)[/b]

We will keep updating the development progress on our social channels.

Please look forward to the official release of “The Patcher” in future.

Thank you for your support.

[b]Pixelity "The Patcher" Operation Team[/b]

notes.title: The 2nd OBT Special Event
notes.content:
Dear Patchers, 

To express our gratitude to all beta testers, we present a special event as below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40473470/a2e4c3626d4906b941bc6a6e35b7f3721567d47b.png[/img]

[b]1. Hot Time Event[/b]
[list]
[*]Event Period: Mar 11th, 2022 ~ OBT ends
[*]Time: 18:00~22:00 (PST) / 01:00~05:00(UTC) / 11:00~15:00(KST)
[*]Event Details:
After each battle, the earned EXP and the Pigcell & Orgadyum from the Deathmatch, Battlefield, and Boss Raid will be doubled during the event hours.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40473470/a4145a00bead08822eee5bdccf90f1a0910574c6.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Event Period: Mar 11th, 2022 ~ OBT ends
[*]Event Reward: The 2nd OBT Special Pack (to be given on the official launch)
[*]How to Participate:
Please leave a reply on this post with your Steam account that you are participating in and achieve account level 10(Sniffer II) or higher. You are eligible to receive the reward. When the game is officially launched, you will receive the reward.
[/list]

[b]2-2. Special Merchandise Giveaway[/b]
[list]
[*]Event period: Mar 11th, 2022 ~ OBT ends
[*]Event Reward: "The Patcher" merchandise package (Total 10 Patchers)
[*]How to Participate:
Participate in the event 2-1 and among those, the top ten highest account level patchers will receive the reward. If more than ten users with the highest account level, they will be selected on a first-come, first-served basis. The top ten winners will be asked their postal address to receive the merchandise reward.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40473470/5fff8be4516008970907d7bd203e15212f37c0fc.png[/img]

Participate in the events to make sure you make the most of its magnificent benefits. See you in game!

Thank You.

[b]Pixelity Games “The Patcher” Operation team[/b]

notes.title: The 2nd Open Beta has started!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=iy8gSYVJaIU;full][/previewyoutube]
Dear Patchers,

The 2nd Open Beta of “The Patcher” has begun!

Press the "Demo" button on the store page to install or update.

For this Open Beta, we offer you the new content as below.

[olist]
[*][b]Boss Raid Mode[/b]
[list]
[*]A large-scale combat mode in PvPvE: both camps have to clash against each other while the giant boss Tantalus is in the center attacks both camps.
Various rewards provided from each mission in the Boss-Raid

[/list]


[*][b]New weapons
[/b]Diversification in functions and stat such as attack types and range
Able to obtain through account level-up, Battlefield bosses rewards, Boss-Raid rewards, or store purchases

[*][b]New skills: ‘Execution’ & ‘Dash’[/b]
Execution: eliminate the opponent with a sword. 
Dash: widens and narrows the distance from the opponent instantly.
Able to obtain these skills from the cartridges.

[*][b]Main UI improvement[/b]
Major UI/UX reorganization
Introduction of equippable weapon inventory

[*]Tutorial
In-game voice improvement

[*]Fixed minor bugs 
[/olist]
If you have any inconveniences or suggestions during the gameplay, please email feedback@pixelitygames.com. 

Your support will help us significantly enhance the "The Patcher's" completeness through this 2nd open beta. Also, if you kindly leave an email on the [url=http://thepatchervr.com/]pre-registration page[/url] or join our [url=https://discord.com/channels/884343898149879869/918056617268871178]Discord channel[/url], we will deliver the latest news.

Thank You,

[b]Pixelity Games "The Patcher" Operation Team[/b]


[i]*Please be cautious that the game records of the beta test will be initialized after the test period.[/i]

notes.title: The Patcher's 1st Open Beta started!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40473470/690f24af67e5b4a172dcfac4701ba9f2fff0ffd8.png[/img]

Dear Patchers,

The first beta test of [b]“The Patcher”[/b] has started!

You can install or update through '[b]DEMO[/b]' button!

This time, we introduce some new features and improve the existing contents.

[list]
[*]New Hunting Ground: Battlefield
[*]New Game System: Shop and Skills
[*]Tutorial and Deathmatch improved
[*]Optimization and minor bugs fixed
[*]Valve Index and HP Reverb G2 support
[/list]

In addition, as you play the game, if there is anything to share and suggest, please feel free to post on the Steam community or send us an Email to feedback@pixelitygames.com. We will review your words to improve our game. Your valuable opinions will be appreciated.

Through this beta, we would like to ask for your support for [b]“The Patcher”[/b] to make the game perfect.

Also, if you leave your Email address on [url=http://thepatchervr.com/]the pre-registration page[/url], we will share the latest news about "The Patcher" right away!

Thank you.

[b]Pixelity Games "The Patcher" Operation Team[/b]


[i]*Please be cautious that the game records of the beta test will be initialised after the test period.[/i]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest 2021 over
notes.content:
Dear Patchers,

Thank you for your eager passion and interest in our demo during the Steam Next Fest 2021 period.

As Steam Next Fest 2021 June Edition is over, the demo version on the Store page is closed.

Another beta test version of "The Patcher" will be back in this July.

Please stay tuned for more upcoming information here in this Discussion forum or our social media.

Thank you.
